rows.label: Legal basis
rows.value: Provinces legislate on direct taxation within the province and on municipal institutions (Constitution Act, 1867, s. 92(2) and (8)); municipal and school property taxes rest on provincial law and are listed on each province's page

rows.label: Federal Underused Housing Tax
rows.value: None for 2025 and later years: no tax and no return (Underused Housing Tax Act s. 1.1, 6.1); the annual 1% tax still applies to 2022 to 2024
